utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive, but I’d like to know the timing and who’s handling pickup. I just want to make sure we’ve got the logistics sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help sort that out — I’ll check the timing and line up pickup details with the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that would really help. Once you have the timing and pickup details, please let me know so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive looking at?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still trying to pin that down, but late afternoon would be best for me. If that works, I can let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon should be workable for me too—just send me the time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet, honestly — I just heard it’s to help folks get basic repairs done around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — that sounds useful. Let me know if you hear what kinds of repairs they’re covering.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking we gather the broken stuff near the community center, sort it by what needs fixing, and then we’ll match each item with someone who can help. Want me to set up a simple sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thank you. I’ll send Oren the details now and get that supplies list wrapped up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably a little late, but I can help with whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane — I’m glad you’re here. Do you want to take the tool sorting or the pickup list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It starts at 10 a.m. at the community hall, and if you can, bring work gloves and any spare tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 10 a.m. at the community hall, with work gloves and any spare tools. I’ll bring those.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you handle the sign-up sheet and follow up with the volunteers? That would really help keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll take care of the sign-up sheet and check in with the volunteers. Just give me the details and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with setup, sorting supplies, or checking in volunteers—what would be most useful?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive spots. Tell me where you need me to go next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you head to the west lot first and check which spots still need tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll head to the west lot and note which spots still need tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll pass that along and keep you posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean it’s still on, right? I just want to confirm the details before I say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still on—I just missed whether anything changed. What do you need me to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donations by type and set them by the garage at 3 tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations by type and have them by the garage at 3 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—thanks, Oren! I’ll swing by the bulletin board and send you the first item as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds fine—just make sure you’ve got the details written down so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely, I’ll jot everything down and keep it organized. I’ll check the bulletin board and bring back the first detail as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you really haven’t heard anything yet? Just let me know if you do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’ll tell you as soon as I hear anything on my route.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring some duct tape, a screwdriver, and any spare screws you’ve got? If you can, also help patch the loose shelf in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I can bring the duct tape, screwdriver, and any spare screws I’ve got. I’ll help patch the shelf too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make a simple list of what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll jot down the main repairs and send them over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Mara. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and check the list for anything we’re still missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and compare them against the list for anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or share the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please share the details with me first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at the community center, and we’ll have tools, snacks, and folks helping fix small household items. If you want, I can also save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening. What location are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard second-hand that it’s starting near the community center—does that sound right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that sounds right to me. I’ll note the community center as the starting location for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll go over the repair drive details and let you know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I’m glad you’re thinking about the repair drive — I can help connect folks if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — yeah, that’d be great. I’m a little scattered, but I’d appreciate the help connecting people.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can reach out to a couple folks and help get everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping things off all morning. If you need the details, I can go ask around and bring back the latest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear. If you’d like, I can swing by with a few tools and help out too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Gus—I'm sure they could use another pair of hands. I’ll let you know if I hear where you’d be most helpful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, what time does the repair drive start, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m not sure of the exact start time yet, so I should check before I tell you. I’ll confirm what to bring too and let you know right away.
